app.name: prism-router
app.title: Prism R4 Router
app.purpose: Decides, for one value of one piece of content coming into the Prism, whether one feature of the Prism maps it: the R4 router sends each value of the content's own schema through the features compiled into the Prism, so the Prism holds the owner's data in its own terms. A value the source's schema already types is mapped straight, free text is read by every compiled feature, a feature whose compiled model is missing is skipped, bytes that are not the compiled model never touch the owner's data, and the kill switch stops every mapping.

fields.name: source
fields.means: the schema the content arrived in: the owner's own words, a mail message, a calendar event, or a contact card

fields.name: value
fields.means: which value of that schema: free text, a subject or summary line, a start time the schema types, the person the schema names, or the shape of the parts it is built of (which headers, parts, attendees and links it has, never what they say)

fields.name: feature
fields.means: the Prism feature to map it onto: when it happens, what it asks of the owner (a task, an event, a question or a fact), who it is with, what it means, what kind of thing it is (a person writing, an invitation, an update, a receipt, travel or a notice), and what it is about in the words the owner's own content keeps using

fields.name: provider
fields.means: the model compiled into the Prism that provides the feature: present with its pinned bytes, absent, or present with other bytes

fields.name: halted
fields.means: whether the owner pressed the kill switch

meanings.map: a compiled feature maps the value
meanings.direct: the value is mapped straight by its schema

rules.says: when halted is yes then refuse
rules.why: Prism R4 Router: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when provider is mismatch then refuse
rules.why: Prism R4 Router: the decision tree's path to refuse

rules.says: when value is start and feature is time and source is note then skip
rules.why: Prism R4 Router: the decision tree's path to skip

rules.says: when value is start and feature is time and source is contact then skip
rules.why: Prism R4 Router: the decision tree's path to skip

rules.says: when value is start and feature is time then direct
rules.why: Prism R4 Router: the decision tree's path to direct

rules.says: when value is start then skip
rules.why: Prism R4 Router: the decision tree's path to skip

rules.says: when value is party and feature is party and source is note then skip
rules.why: Prism R4 Router: the decision tree's path to skip

rules.says: when value is party and feature is party then direct
rules.why: Prism R4 Router: the decision tree's path to direct

rules.says: when value is party then skip
rules.why: Prism R4 Router: the decision tree's path to skip

rules.says: when value is shape and feature is kind and provider is absent then skip
rules.why: Prism R4 Router: the decision tree's path to skip

rules.says: when value is shape and feature is kind then map
rules.why: Prism R4 Router: the decision tree's path to map

rules.says: when value is shape then skip
rules.why: Prism R4 Router: the decision tree's path to skip

rules.says: when provider is absent then skip
rules.why: Prism R4 Router: the decision tree's path to skip

app.otherwiseWhy: Prism R4 Router: the decision tree's path that meets no test

properties.says: always when halted is yes then refuse
properties.why: the kill switch stops every mapping

properties.says: always when halted is no and provider is mismatch then refuse
properties.why: bytes that are not the compiled model never touch the owner's data

properties.says: never when provider is absent then map
properties.why: no feature runs without the model compiled into the Prism for it

properties.says: always when halted is no and provider is compiled and value is text then map
properties.why: the owner's free text is read by every compiled feature, so nothing they wrote is held as a bare string

properties.says: always when halted is no and provider is compiled and value is subject then map
properties.why: a subject line is free text too

properties.says: never when value is start then map
properties.why: a time the source's schema already types is never re-read by a model

properties.says: never when value is party then map
properties.why: a person the source's schema already names is never re-read by a model

properties.says: always when halted is no and provider is absent and source is calendar and value is start and feature is time then direct
properties.why: a calendar event's own start lands on the Prism's time feature even with no model

properties.says: never when source is note and value is start then direct
properties.why: the owner's words carry no typed start: their time is read, never assumed

properties.says: always when halted is no and provider is compiled and value is shape and feature is kind then map
properties.why: what kind of thing an item is is read from the parts it is built of

properties.says: never when value is shape and feature is topic then map
properties.why: the parts an item is built of never say what it is about

properties.says: never when value is shape and feature is topic then direct
properties.why: the parts an item is built of never say what it is about

properties.says: never when value is shape and feature is party then map
properties.why: the parts an item is built of never say who it is with

properties.says: never when value is shape and feature is party then direct
properties.why: the parts an item is built of never say who it is with

properties.says: always when halted is no and provider is compiled and value is text and feature is topic then map
properties.why: what the owner's content is about is read in its own words
